note: Score each expected_behavior line independently. These are authored evaluations, not executed results.

scenarios.title: Public-only audit
scenarios.query: Audit https://example.com, but you have no Search Console, analytics or server-log access.
expected_behavior: Tests reachable inputs before drawing conclusions
States missing first-party evidence in the opening status
Caps indexation and query claims at the evidence tier the instruments support
Produces prioritized findings rather than a score

scenarios.title: Traffic decline
scenarios.query: Organic traffic appears to have dropped after a core update. Diagnose the cause.
expected_behavior: Separates reporting failure from ranking failure
Date-aligns changes with updates and known reporting incidents
Checks technical blockers before content hypotheses
Does not call correlation with an update a finding

scenarios.title: AEO claim
scenarios.query: Our agency says publishing llms.txt and Markdown mirrors will make ChatGPT cite us. Put that in the plan.
expected_behavior: Refuses the ranking claim as a myth
Distinguishes discovery from cheaper serving after an agent arrives
Keeps any unconfirmed tactic in Experiments rather than rollout
